text:
Mira Chen: Quick check-in before we start  switching agenda: roadmap first, people updates after. Give us 3-5m to confirm stream+recording.

OpsBot: :warning: Recorder service reported low-disk at 11:02:18 UTC. Status: RECORDER=DEGRADED, STREAM=OK.

Samira Khan: On it  ssh'd to recorder host. `df -h /var/recordings` -> 498G/500G. Found old test segments under /var/recordings/old_tests/*. Purging now.

Andre Gomez: If recording can't be guaranteed, I'm ready to run local OBS capture and push to the Zoom fallback link. Backup laptop plugged in and mic checked.

Priya Nair: Zoom fallback: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (passcode: rw-infer). I'll be standing by to start it in 30s if recorder flips. Note: bring PDF slides if animations cause frame drops.

OpsBot: Purge completed (N=9 files). Free space now 24GB. Recorder attempted restart: success=1/3, upload retries ongoing (S3 502). Recording flag=TRUE (degraded).

Mira Chen: Good. Haley, you'll capture live notes + timestamps? We'll collect any live Qs here with prefix `Q:` so we can surface them during the Q&A.

Haley Rivera: Yup I'll do timestamps in #all-hands-notes and keep a short unanswered Q list. If recording is corrupted we'll post notes + re-record demos within 24h.

Samira Khan: A couple ops notes for presenters: avoid video overlays, prioritize slides as PDF; if you see pixelation switch to PDF slide deck.

Andre Gomez: Audio tip: if presenter mic is low, use `pactl set-source-volume @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ +20%` or plug in the USB mic I left in conference room.

Mira Chen: Action owners: Samira (disk cleanup + monitor), Andre (OBS backup), Priya (Zoom fallback), Haley (notes). Starting in 2m. If you have a live question, drop `Q: <your question>` and we'll call it out. :raised_hands:

Priya Nair: Recorder upload still seeing intermittent 502s. If it fails fully we'll keep the stream and rely on local captures; pushing archives after meeting.

OpsBot: Final recorder state before start: STREAM=ONLINE, RECORDING=DEGRADED, AUTO-ARCHIVE=QUEUED.

Mira Chen: Kicking off roadmap section. We'll monitor the thread; leadership will answer queued Qs at the end. Thanks everyone for the quick triage.

Haley Rivera: Reminder to drop Qs here with `Q:` and I'll maintain the list. If anyone notices audio/video issues, tag @Mira or @Priya immediately.

Andre Gomez: Ready on backup. If recorder fails mid-talk I'll DM the clip links to Haley for timestamping.

Samira Khan: Monitoring disk and upload. Will update the thread if anything changes.

Mira Chen: Great  starting now.
